authority: T0 exact finite-volume analytic theorem: for a centered summable exponential local-energy weight, the exact ST8/Q3LOCK current has a volume- and compact-source-uniform one-sided A-bounded derivative. This closes A^2, A^(3/2), propagation of the energy domain D(A^(3/4)), and the boundary position multiplier. Scalar power counting identifies 3/4 as a necessary target for a one-sided cubic multiplier, but the noncommuting embedding q^3 A^-3/4 remains open. A conditional two-sided Duhamel theorem reduces thermodynamic Cauchy to first/double position-commutator spatial decay. The cubic force generates an infinite half-energy graph ladder, so common alpha remains open.

open_commutator_gate.failure: The first/double-commutator system is not closed; ordered graph estimates create an infinite +1/2 energy ladder.
open_commutator_gate.rejected_separate_rung: For any nonzero upward spectral transition of a bond V, ||K^(j/2)V(t)K^(-(j+1)/2)|| has an exponential lower bound in j, uniformly in t; no C(j+1)^alpha estimate can hold.
open_commutator_gate.surviving_base_rung: For K_xy>=gamma(|q_x|^4+|q_y|^4), both ||V_xy(t)K_xy^(-1/2)|| and its adjoint orientation are at most c/sqrt(2gamma).
open_commutator_gate.replacement_targets: Prove a direct product-level Volterra/linked-cluster estimate, a heat/strip-loss analytic-ideal theorem that never commutes growing powers through each bond, or a KMS-specific state-weighted positivity theorem; then construct a noncollapsing Hamiltonian-derived finite-density algebra.
open_commutator_gate.convex_subregime_boundary: For 0<=lambda<=2g the quartic is convex, but a faithful 3x3 weighted commutator fixture has negative expectation, so convexity alone does not supply the required operator/state-weighted LR sign.
gevrey_boundaries: Fixed-chain time-simplex convergence does not control factorial lattice-animal multiplicity.
The first graph rung does not justify commuting allocated heat factors through V_e(t).
Centered summable spatial weights can accumulate exp[O(mu n^2)] costs.
Heat-smoothed finite-energy ideals are not norm dense in the unital label algebra and do not automatically contain thermal phases.
